messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key navigation on the board. Unmodified arrow keys move focus within the row or column, stop at board edges, and use the existing nearest-scroll behavior. Other keys and modifier combinations are left to the browser; Enter and Space still activate cards through native button behavior.

The existing browser tests cover arrow movement, edge stops, and Tab exit, but I did not run checks.
